facts.text: Run cloud migration setup for Dynamics SL migration before configuring company migration.
Open SL Company Migration Configuration page from Cloud Migration Management, then select Configure SL Migration.
Set Dimension 1 and Dimension 2 in the Per Company section by selecting Dynamics SL subaccount segments for global dimensions.
Choose which modules to migrate: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Inventory are selected by default.
Specify the Oldest GL Year field for general ledger data to control how many years back to migrate.
Open purchase orders require General Ledger, Accounts Payable, and Inventory. Open sales orders require General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, and Inventory.
Most global settings are copied to company-level settings, but Include Hold Status Resources and Include Plan Status Projects are not copied.
